description: Look through the connected mailboxes for newsletters and list the publications sending them, with how many arrived and how many the owner opened. Reads no bodies and changes nothing: this is the question, not the answer. Each sender comes back with a `status` — 'undecided' means the owner has never said, 'allowed' means read it, 'blocked' means do not. Our guess at what each one is rides on `classification`: 'newsletter' for something written, 'promotion' for a retailer. The guess only sorts the list; the owner decides. Show them the undecided ones, most frequent first, say which look like promotions, and ask which they want read.

days.description: How far back to look. Default 30.

name: find_my_newsletters
title: Find my newsletters
